title: Gemma 4 Technical Report
selection_reason: The report describes several concrete inference optimizations: local/global attention and KV sharing reduce global KV-cache footprint by up to 37.5%; an autoregressive multi-token-prediction head is released for speculative decoding; quantized checkpoints reduce parameter memory; and the 150M image encoder's W8A8 quantization halves forward-pass memory and reduces on-device latency by 44%. These are direct LLM/multimodal inference efficiency contributions, rather than only a model-capability report.
